title: Generalization Testing of Grid Foundation Models for Power Flow and Optimal Power Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.19194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: There is growing interest in foundation models (FMs) for power grids, particularly for power flow and optimal power flow. Their usefulness depends on generalization accuracy, which existing works test on their own benchmarks. We propose a three-axis framework to test their generalization limits: changed admittance matrices of training grids, load levels, and unseen grids. We test GENCO, LUMINA and GridSFM against the DC baseline, alongside their reported limitations, and discuss theoretical reasons for their failures. Experiments reveal that adding a line degrades all FMs more than removing one, and longer lines eventually make LUMINA and fine-tuned GENCO worse than DC. All three degrade beyond their training load range, where the loading-voltage curve steepens. translated_title: 电网基础模型在潮流计算与最优潮流中的泛化能力测试
translated_abstract: 电网基础模型日益受到关注，尤其是在潮流计算和最优潮流领域。其实用性取决于泛化精度，而现有工作都在各自自建的基准上进行测试。我们提出了一个三轴框架来测试其泛化极限：训练电网的导纳矩阵变化、负荷水平变化以及未见过的电网。我们将 GENCO、LUMINA 和 GridSFM 与直流潮流基线进行对比测试，并结合它们已被报告的局限性，讨论了其失效的理论原因。实验表明，增加一条线路对所有基础模型性能的损害大于移除一条线路，且当线路更长时，LUMINA 和微调后的 GENCO 最终表现劣于直流潮流基线。当超出训练负荷范围时，三种模型均出现退化，此时负荷-电压曲线变得更加陡峭。在未见过的电网上，LUMINA 即使在训练负荷范围内也出现急剧退化，而 GridSFM 在与其训练电网相距最远的电网上失效。因此，在超出训练条件的情况下，基础模型的表现更像是……
tldr: 提出了一个三轴泛化测试框架，系统评估 GENCO、LUMINA 和 GridSFM 等电网基础模型在导纳矩阵变化、负荷水平变化和未见电网上的泛化极限，发现它们在超出训练条件时性能显著退化，甚至劣于直流潮流基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes a three-axis generalization testing framework to evaluate grid foundation models (GENCO, LUMINA, GridSFM) on changed admittance matrices, load levels, and unseen grids, revealing that their performance degrades significantly beyond training conditions, sometimes falling below the DC power flow baseline.
